svg.title: OpenVeil: people veiled, the subject of the footage visible
svg.desc: Four drawn scenes, each watched by a camera: a calf barn, a factory line with a robot arm, a laboratory bench and a meadow with a deer. In every scene the one person present is covered by a pixel mosaic with a green tick, while the calves, the machine, the instruments and the deer stay visible. A dashed box with a cross on one calf and on the deer marks a candidate the verifier rejected. No real people or footage.
